credits.title: Algeria Violet
credits.overview: A film about the plight of a young girl in a small village in eastern Turkey who is coerced to become a child-wife for an already married older man.

credits.title: Rafadan Tayfa: Göbeklitepe
credits.overview: The discovery of Göbeklitepe and the subsequent excavations caused great excitement around the world. During the days when all eyes were on Göbeklitepe, Akın received a mysterious package from his friend Veysi in Şanlıurfa.
